newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel retreats as Iraq tensions cool.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel retreats as Iraq tensions cool.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell sharply Friday with crude futures, traders said, erasing Thursday gains as the market relaxed amid reports Iraq had pledged to suspend military action.
Although October futures slumped 1.23 cents a gallon, traders said differentials remained fairly steady.
They weakened about 0.25 cent on New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade jet, with offers at about 4.20 cents above October futures, players said.
Gulf Coast 54-grade was bid at about 1.15 cents above the print, 0.15 cent firmer than Thursday, traders said.
"The cash market hasn't been that liquid; values are sort of holding," one Gulf trader said. "Sellers didn't panic and buyers aren't that anxious to come to the table."
